rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.0025, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.001, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-11 DECAY probe. Optimizer space peaked at GD lr=0.01: iter-9 adam collapsed hr->0, iter-10 lr 0.01->0.02 hurt 0.36286->0.29146. Revert lr=0.01. With tv_decay=0.01 the GD step at iter1000 = 0.01/(1+0.01*1000) ~= 0.0009 (11x shrunk) => late convergence is step-starved while the TV term is still descending. ONE knob: tv_decay 0.01->0.001 (10x less decay; step at iter1000 = 0.01/2 = 0.005 vs 0.0009). Keep gd, lambda=2.5e-3, lr=0.01, 1000 iters, fbp. HYPOTHESIS: larger late steps converge the TV term further within 1000 iters so hr rises past 0.36286; if too-large late steps oscillate/destabilize (hr drops) decay=0.01 was protective and I revert + add iterations. Budget: ~950s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
